vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Value-Added Tax on taxable supplies of goods and services in The Gambia, and on goods imported.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value-added tax on taxable supplies of goods and services in the gambia, and on goods imported.
vat_rates.legal_reference: Income and Value Added Tax Act, 2012 (named at item 15 of the GRA brochure's offences section); GRA VAT Brochure: "The standard VAT rate is 15 percent. This rate is applied to all goods and services unless they are specifically exempted." The 2013-01-01 effective date is NOT stated in the brochure itself and was not re-verified against a primary document in this cycle -- treat as indicative only until confirmed.

vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: GRA VAT Brochure: "Zero percent is applied to exports of goods and services."
